notes.title: Dev Log: Patch #16 - Balancing Acts
notes.content:
[b]You ever had someone tell you that your soup is good but it sorta taste like feet? Specifically in our case the KUR soup-of-the-day didn't have ENOUGH of that feet taste.[/b]

Look - what we're trying to say is that we've reworked the boot a bit. Boot-Jumping now works on a 'buffer' and should behave as expected much more consistently. On top of this, the dashing and the basic kick no longer cost energy. The goal here is to make the boot and movement in general feel a bit more intuitive. Overall we think these changes should make utilizing the boot much easier & more fluid.

Aside from the boot rework we've been busy fixing those pesky bugs and balancing the game! Some of you may have noticed the new vending machines in some of the recent patches. All ammo, weapons, health, and energy can now be primarily found in the vending machines available to purchase for Cash that you earn throughout the game. After all, you are a cold-blooded mercenary in it for the thrill and riches!  From a game-dev perspective this allows us to not only tie in a little tongue-in-cheek lore but it also let's us balance the entire game much faster! All of the in-game pickups are now dynamically balanced per level depending on several factors including enemy count, health available, cash available, difficulty, etc. Overall we're working hard to polish up the level to level experience in KUR. Combat encounters should start feeling tighter and ammo management should take more of a toll if you're careless. Long story short, count your bullets and stack your paper if you want to make it through KUR.

As usual please report any bugs you find, we see them all and we are determined to fix em'. [url=https://t.co/rPhGSf8vnK]Please don't come into our discord and yell at us about all the feet metaphors![/url]

On top of this, the dashing and the basic kick no longer cost energy.
All ammo, weapons, health, and energy can now be primarily found in the vending machines available to purchase for Cash that you earn throughout the game.
All of the in-game pickups are now dynamically balanced per level depending on several factors including enemy count, health available, cash available, difficulty, etc.

notes.title: DEV LOG: Patch #10 - Incoming, Mercs!
notes.content:
[b]Blood and guts, but make it [i]shiny[/i].[/b]

We’re back for another Dev Log! I'm Kehran Carr, the aforementioned other half of Really Ragdoll. This past week we've been hard at work wrapping up the last of our major content in the game. From here on out, the bulk of our work will be polish, polish, and more polish. Balancing too, but we’ve got to make it all shiny first! 

The final boss is in...well on our side. We're still play-testing things and getting the right boss music in before we push it out, but he lives! As Brian mentioned last week, we take pride in our most obscure boss fights so we want the big finale feeling good before you boot kickers get to see it.  However, if I may toot our own Really Ragdoll horn, the last boss will be quite the challenge... an accumulation of the bosses faced before, remixed. I don't want to say too much or spoil it but we're pumped and we hope it delivers a "Boot-Meets-Ass" ending to KUR! 

Aside from that, I've somehow managed to get localization working (Chinese, Russian, and Spanish) and the remaining achievements coded. We're still working on steam art for the rest of the achievements but completionists, we see you and we love you. 

Also, I can't forget to mention the MOOLA, BREAD, CHEESE, CHEDDAR, DOUGH, sometimes referred to as CASH. The entire cash system has had a bit of balancing love, but we need your help to make it feel[i] just right[/i]. So get out there & blast some A.I.C. Briefcases open! Then yell at us if things feel too easy, hard, or unbalanced.

I stalk these steam forums way more than I'd like to admit... but the feedback so far has been amazing, thank you! I think I can speak for everyone at Really Ragdoll when I say we want to make KUR better and [i]we are listening[/i]. The next several updates probably won't be big content drops but we're committed to delivering a polished release build. 

Join our discord or hit us up on twitter if you have any bug reports, feedback, or suggestions! 

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/ReallyRagdoll]www.twitter.com/ReallyRagdoll[/url]
Discord: [url=https://bit.ly/KURDiscord]https://bit.ly/KURDiscord[/url]

notes.title: Patch 7: KUR Version Update 0.8.1 is out!
notes.content:
Happy KURsday!! 

It’s been a while but did you think we were just sitting on our thumbs?! Nope! We’ve got a juicy update for you today, chalk full of bug fixes, polish, and some new content! There are greed inducing new cash rewards on level completion and leaderboards to see how you stack up against your fellow boot babes! Another big part of this update is a save system overhaul. Loading and saving should be much more reliable now but an unfortunate side effect is that some older saves may not load properly. Sorry for any inconvenience this might cause and thank you for your patience and feedback as we get KUR ready for full release!

Stay with us because we are working hard and have more updates coming your way soon!

Updates
[list]
[*] Cash Rewards for completing levels. These cash rewards are integrated into the boot upgrade system.
[*] Leaderboards for cash obtained in levels.
[*] A new intro gauntlet and final fiery challenge in the Factory.
[*] Juicy ragdoll Hammerhead corpses that can be interacted with and gibbed for more gore!
[*] Added blue plasma blood decals.
[*] New enemies and challenges in the Atrium.
[*] New sound effects throughout.
[/list]


Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Save system overhaul
[*] Loading is more reliable. (But some older saves may no longer work, sorry!)
[*] Auto and quick saving no longer causes a big drop in framerate.
[*] Fixed various dialog and subtitle bugs.
[*] Fixed some magnetic resources lingering with the magnetic boot upgrade.
[*] Fixed a bug causing some Tide Pod enemies to not behave correctly upon loading.
[*] Too many small level bug fixes to list here.
[/list]

notes.title: KUR's Patch Numero Uno! V. 0.7.5A is available now for all players.
notes.content:
[b]Hello there, all you badass boot-wearing mercs![/b]

We've updated KUR today with a lot of fixes based on your feedback - take a look through the patch notes below and we'll answer any further questions over in the discussions tab. 

Version Number: 0.7.5A

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Fixed various texture uv maps.
-Fixed a bug where unchecking fullscreen toggle wouldn't switch to windowed mode
* Anyone experiencing high GPU demand can now try windowed mode while possible bottlenecks get worked out
-Fixed a bug where boot abilities wouldn't reset when starting a new game.
-Fixed a possible blocker in level 3 with spider webs if taking a sneaky secret route.
-Fixed level 2 end_level trigger and door console.
-Fixed purple door in level 3 leading to unfinished cafeteria secret.
-Fixed stats manager not loading properly when opening game
-Fixed bug causing CPU Fan enemy to not play death animation.
-Fixed bug causing Skull Snail enemy to occasionally stand still after attacking.
-Fixed bug causing enemies to be frozen with any gun after using and holstering Mr. Freeze.
-Fixed an occlusion bug in level 8 causing the locked red door to be invisible at some angles.
-Fixed bug causing fish to freeze when out of water.
-Fixed bug causing fish to behave oddly when retreating from player.
-Fixed Tiny Tim boss ui to show if loading save after the fight occurred.

[b]Changes[/b]

-Reduced ammo drops in the tunnel entry room in the Factory Level.
-Integrated game difficulty with some ranged weapon cooldowns and attack delays.
-Integrated game difficulty with environmental damaging obstacles.
-The number of stim packs dropped by Bloodlust Boot Upgrade will now depend on the maximum health of the enemy killed.
-Slight reduction to aim assist amount for Big Boy Roy laser gatling gun
-Updated end level stats to be more accurate. 
-Enemy hit animations now play more consistently.
-Parkour boot is now easier and more consistent.
-Player drag while in air is now more significant if no direction input is detected.
-Vsync is now a slider in the options menu.
-Increase Darwin health in level 7.
-Reduced Tiny Tim slowdown from damage in level 1.
-Made the vent to access the red key card less hidden in level 8.
-Reduced hellfire DPS.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We'd just like to say thank you for trying out our demo and giving KUR a shot! We've been working hard with our ear to the ground, and we present to you a hotfix :) [strike]yeah yeah, it's only a demo hotfix, alpha update on the way <3[/strike]

 - Skull Snails now gib on death (should help performance)
 - Hint flares added...stop getting lost noobs ;)

[h1]Lazy Devs...whut you doin!?[/h1]
 - More options on the way! (headbob toggle, tilt toggle, etc)
 - Levels 1-4 & Boss fight update for Alpha (almost ready! New enemy variations just got done)

 - Working on Dialog & Voice Acting
 - More tunes

~ Dev Team
